content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent depictions of violence and gore.

Combat includes dismemberment, with the ability to shoot off enemy limbs, and blood effects such as splatter and pooling on the environment. Some enemy and player death animations are graphic in nature.

There are no depictions of sexual content, non-consensual acts, or drug use.
